title: The Item List of a PAP Supply Replenishment Program Refill Request
content:
## Definition of the item list

**Items of the recorded equipment.** For an enrollment in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the items of the recorded equipment are: the interface and cushion item of the recorded mask style (a full face mask with full face cushions, or a nasal interface with nasal cushions or with nasal pillows); headgear; the tubing in use (heated tubing when heated tubing is in use, otherwise standard tubing); disposable filters; and a water chamber when a humidifier is in use.

**Items listed.** The list holds each item of the recorded equipment whose supply runs out no more than the schedule's ship-window days after the request. An item's supply runs out on the latest covered-through date among its coverage-billed lines, a line a payer later took back still counting because its items were delivered. An item never shipped is not listed.

**Form.** The item list is written as HCPCS codes in ascending order separated by commas.

**Scope.** These supply dates serve the item list only and do not change when a coverage-billed line may ship.

## Items of the recorded equipment by style

| Recorded mask style | Interface | Cushion | Always | Tubing | Water chamber |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| full face | A7030 | A7031 | A7035 headgear, A7038 disposable filters | A4604 if heated tubing is in use, otherwise A7037 | A7046 if a humidifier is in use |
| nasal | A7034 | A7032 | A7035, A7038 | as above | as above |
| nasal pillows | A7034 | A7033 | A7035, A7038 | as above | as above |

Ascending order of the codes that can appear: A4604, A7030, A7031, A7032, A7033, A7034, A7035, A7037, A7038, A7046.

## Worked example (hypothetical enrollment)

Nasal style, standard tubing, no humidifier, a ship window of 10 days, request on 1 June. Latest covered-through dates of coverage-billed lines: nasal interface A7034, 30 August; nasal cushion A7032, 5 June; headgear A7035, 11 June; standard tubing A7037, 12 June; disposable filters A7038, 28 May (that line later taken back by the payer).

| Item | Runs out | Days after 1 June | Listed (10 days or fewer) |
|---|---|---|---|
| A7032 | 5 June | 4 | yes |
| A7034 | 30 August | 90 | no |
| A7035 | 11 June | 10 | yes |
| A7037 | 12 June | 11 | no |
| A7038 | 28 May | already run out | yes (the taken-back line still counts) |

Item list: A7032,A7035,A7038.
